trigger: eICU schema inspection before cohort lock: icd9code found to be a deterministic re-encoding of diagnosisstring
decision: Primary phenotype changed from Paper 1's ICD code list to 35 enumerated diagnosisstring paths; unspecified-stroke stays included; APACHE admission diagnosis retained as the single independent cross-check

trigger: Cohort feasibility measured: 8,279 patients across 176 hospitals
decision: Single suggested hospital threshold replaced by a tiered rule; leave-one-hospital-out promoted to the primary Aim 3 analysis

trigger: Frozen model inspection: the four organ-support flags are the strongest state discriminators and the least transportable variables
decision: 17-variable treatment-free model transported as a prespecified specificity control reported with equal prominence; four-cell interpretation table fixed

trigger: Review of v1.0, which declined any similarity threshold
decision: Quantitative thresholds prespecified for the two structural metrics; prevalence kept descriptive; permutation nulls added

trigger: Frozen-parameter export: P(CRRT=1) is effectively zero in three of four states, so a CRRT window would receive zero likelihood
decision: Categorical emissions floored at 1e-4 and renormalised; verified on MIMIC to leave decoding identical before use
Laboratory glucose separated from point-of-care glucose; GCS non-numeric rule stated; the interval-versus-point-event asymmetry named explicitly

trigger: English and Chinese v1.0 found to have diverged structurally after section 10
decision: Documents merged; English designated normative; Chinese regenerated with matching section numbers

trigger: Blind interface-availability audit, no outcome or state information used
decision: Tier A confirmed; GCS identified as the binding constraint; medication table added as a second drug source; GCS complete-case sensitivity added

trigger: Frozen-parameter verification on MIMIC: the preserved state's gcs_motor emission is a point mass (SD 0.000119) and the discovery imputation median coincides with it
decision: Response is measurement, not repair: prevalence split by observed versus imputed GCS; hospital preserved-state prevalence regressed on GCS coverage; GCS complete-case promoted to a co-reported diagnostic; GCS coverage added as an Aim 3 covariate

trigger: A2 decode collapsed: under eICU scaling the preserved state's own defining value sits 1,256 SD from its emission mean and the state vanishes
decision: A2 recorded as not executable on this model and reported as a methodological result rather than deleted as a failed analysis
classification: Post-assignment (treatment-free control), outcome-blind. The amendment records a deterministic property of the frozen model, not a choice among observed results

trigger: The treatment-free transport produced a minimum profile correlation of 0.709, which fell in the 0.60-0.80 band the criteria had left undefined
decision: Resolved by reporting rule rather than by a new threshold: per-state correlations reported descriptively, stating how many states reach the bar and which do not. No third threshold was introduced
classification: Post-assignment (treatment-free control), outcome-blind. THE MOST SENSITIVE AMENDMENT IN THIS LOG: the gap was identified because an observed value fell into it. It was resolved by removing the need for a threshold rather than by choosing one, precisely so that the observed value could not determine the rule

trigger: Internal inconsistency found in v1.1: the quoted medication-table coverage gain had not applied the continuous-infusion rule stated in the same paragraph
decision: Figures corrected from 37.6% and 13.3% to 18.6% and 12.0%; the rule itself was already stated correctly and did not change

trigger: Clinical adjudication of the enumerated free-text term dictionaries returned
decision: Dictionaries frozen as v1.0 (112 drug names, 73 urine sources, 42 ventilation and CRRT terms); medication table retained on construct grounds with an infusionDrug-only sensitivity analysis and per-hospital capture reporting
classification: Clinical adjudication, outcome-blind. The adjudicator saw term frequencies only, never a state assignment or an outcome

trigger: Hospital respiratory-interface matrix: determinability is unimodal with a median of 25% and a ceiling of 67%, so the interface-present/absent dichotomy the rule assumed does not exist
decision: Ventilation ascertainment resolved at the hospital interface (rule N3). A candidate threshold reproducing the MIMIC ventilation prevalence exactly was REJECTED for having no structural justification, and is recorded as rejected. Ventilation reported as a bracket
classification: Data-blind (interface counts only). The rejected alternative is logged so that it cannot be revisited

trigger: Investigator decision to extend the study from validation of the state structure to one-step-ahead prediction of the next state. Raised after the Aim 1-3 transport, outcome and heterogeneity results were complete and known.
decision: Aim 4 added: predict the state in window t+1 from information through window t. A six-model ladder ordered by information used (persistence null; frozen transition matrix; frozen HMM forward filtering; multinomial logistic; gradient boosting; gradient boosting plus age, sex, subtype and window index). Models requiring fitting are fitted on the MIMIC-IV training split only and frozen before eICU is touched. The primary metric is discrimination for the binary event 'the state differs in the next window', prespecified before any prediction result was computed, because 90.7% of window pairs do not change state and overall accuracy is therefore uninformative.
classification: Post-hoc aim. Transport results were known when this aim was added, and this is the only amendment in the log for which that is true. The frozen parameters are unchanged and the evaluation metric was fixed in advance of computing it, but the aim itself is exploratory and is reported as such.
